name: CalendarGrid
description: Grid of the shown month: a row of weekday names, then six weeks of day buttons. Arrow keys, Home, End, PageUp, and PageDown move the focus between days. Pass a function as children to render each day yourself, usually with `Calendar.DayPrimitive`. Renders a `<table>` element.

props.name: children
props.description: Renders one day of the grid. Defaults to `Calendar.DayPrimitive`.

props.name: className
props.description:
CSS class applied to the element, or a function that
returns a class based on the component's state.

props.name: style
props.description:
Style applied to the element, or a function that
returns a style object based on the component's state.

props.name: render
props.detailedType: ReactElement | ((props: HTMLProps, state: Calendar.Grid.State) => ReactElement) | undefined
props.description:
Allows you to replace the component's HTML element
with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

Accepts a `ReactElement` or a function that returns the element to render.
